_about: 내 데이터로 LLM 파인튜닝하기 2장 출처표. 모든 값은 url을 checked 날짜에 직접 읽고 옮겼다. 값이 바뀌면 고치지 말고 날짜가 다른 새 파일을 만든다.

qwen2.5-7b.role: 예로 든 기본(base) 모델. 추천이나 순위가 아니다. 5장과 같은 모델이다.
qwen2.5-7b.shard_file_sizes_how: 각 파일 resolve URL의 HTTP 응답 헤더 X-Linked-Size
qwen2.5-7b.safetensors_headers_how: 각 파일의 앞 8바이트(헤더 길이 N)를 HTTP Range로 받고, 이어서 0~N+7바이트를 받아 그대로 저장했다. 가중치 값은 들어 있지 않다.

qwen2.5-7b-instruct.role: 같은 기본 모델에서 대화용으로 더 학습한(instruct) 모델. 비교용.

tokenizer_json_counts._how: 두 저장소의 tokenizer.json(7,031,645바이트, 바이트 단위로 같음)을 내려받아 센 값. 파일은 실습 폴더에 넣지 않았다.

libraries.name: Hub
libraries.quote: The Hugging Face Hub hosts Git-based repositories, which are version-controlled folders that can contain all your files.

libraries.name: datasets
libraries.quote: Load a dataset in a single line of code, and use our powerful data processing and streaming methods to quickly get your dataset ready for training in a deep learning model.

libraries.name: tokenizers
libraries.quote: Does all the pre-processing: Truncation, Padding, add the special tokens your model needs.

libraries.name: transformers
libraries.quote: Transformers acts as the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, computer vision, audio, video, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.

libraries.name: bitsandbytes
libraries.quote: bitsandbytes enables accessible large language models via k-bit quantization for PyTorch.

libraries.name: PEFT
libraries.quote: PEFT methods only fine-tune a small number of (extra) model parameters - significantly decreasing computational and storage costs - while yielding performance comparable to a fully fine-tuned model.

libraries.name: TRL
libraries.quote: This class is a wrapper around the Trainer class and inherits all of its attributes and methods.

libraries.name: accelerate
libraries.quote: Accelerate is a library that enables the same PyTorch code to be run across any distributed configuration by adding just four lines of code!

libraries.name: safetensors
libraries.quote: 8 bytes: N, an unsigned little-endian 64-bit integer, containing the size of the header

stages.label: 학습 반복(손실, 기울기, GPU에 나눠 올리기)

requires_dist._how: https://pypi.org/pypi/<이름>/json 의 info.requires_dist에서 extra가 아닌 필수 의존성(위 버전 기준). transformers의 accelerate는 extra == "torch"일 때만 필요해서 따로 적었다.

trl_sft_facts.completion_only_loss_note: None이면 prompt-completion 데이터는 completion에만, language modeling 데이터는 전체에 손실을 매긴다.
trl_sft_facts.default_dtype_note: If `dtype` is not specified in `args.model_init_kwargs`, it defaults to `float32`.
trl_sft_facts.pad_default: If the processing class has not set a padding token, `tokenizer.eos_token` will be used as the default.

transformers_chat_template_facts.add_special_tokens_warning: When you format text with `apply_chat_template(tokenize=False)`, make sure you set `add_special_tokens=False` if you tokenize later to avoid duplicating these tokens.
transformers_chat_template_facts.training_note: Set `add_generation_prompt=False` because the additional tokens to prompt an assistant response aren't helpful during training.

hub_facts.revision_note: When using the commit hash, it must be the full-length hash instead of a 7-character commit hash.
hub_facts.library_name_note: For model repos created after August 2024, this is not the case anymore, so you need to set `library_name: transformers` explicitly.

peft_facts.note: this also means that to load a PEFT model, you need to have the original model available as well.
